title: Surreal Martian Portrait
description: A large circular emblem dominates a cracked desert landscape under a red sky. The emblem features a split-face hybrid of a green-skinned woman with closed eyes and a red rat-like creature with an open eye, with a tiny silhouetted figure walking inside the third eye on her forehead; a lone astronaut walks toward it, casting a long shadow, with a purple moon and a ringed red planet in the background.
prompt: A surreal desert scene on a cracked barren plain under a deep red sky, featuring a massive circular emblem with intricate geometric border containing a split-face hybrid: the left side is a green-skinned woman with closed eyes, black braided hair with lavender, and earrings, the right side is a red rat-like creature with sharp teeth and open eye, a small silhouetted figure walking inside a third eye on the forehead, a lone astronaut in blue suit walking towards the emblem casting a long shadow, purple cratered moon and a large red ringed planet with atmospheric bands in the sky, detailed textures, symbolic and mystical atmosphere
